question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Beloved, Bob gets Emma, Claire gets The Hobbit, Dave gets Dracula, and Eve gets Jane Eyre.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Claire swap books. Then, Eve and Claire swap books. Then, Bob and Alice swap books. Then, Alice and Bob swap books. Finally, Alice and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Beloved
(B) Emma
(C) The Hobbit
(D) Dracula
(E) Jane Eyre
solution:
Book order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: Beloved | Emma | The Hobbit | Dracula | Jane Eyre
1. Alice ↔ Claire: The Hobbit | Emma | Beloved | Dracula | Jane Eyre
2. Eve ↔ Claire: The Hobbit | Emma | Jane Eyre | Dracula | Beloved
3. Bob ↔ Alice: Emma | The Hobbit | Jane Eyre | Dracula | Beloved
4. Alice ↔ Bob: The Hobbit | Emma | Jane Eyre | Dracula | Beloved
5. Alice ↔ Bob: Emma | The Hobbit | Jane Eyre | Dracula | Beloved
Bob has The Hobbit, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
